STANDARD OPERATING PROCEDURES
Employee Offboarding & IT Asset Recovery SOP
Separation Workflows, SCIM Access Revocation, Hardware Recovery, and Handover
Classification: Internal
Version: 3.8
Owner: People Operations & IT Security
Review Cycle: Annual
1. Purpose and Scope
This SOP establishes the operational procedures for managing voluntary and involuntary departures at Apex Global
Technologies. The primary objective is to safeguard corporate assets, protect intellectual property, ensure compliance
with data privacy regulations, and facilitate a professional transition.
2. Offboarding Timelines and Departmental Notifications
Voluntary Resignations: Employee submits formal resignation in BambooHR with a minimum of two (2) weeks
notice. People Operations automatically initiates the offboarding workflow notifying the Manager, IT Support, Security,
and Payroll.
Involuntary Separations: People Operations and Legal coordinate directly with IT Security to execute real-time
access revocation precisely at the conclusion of the separation meeting.

4. Physical Hardware Recovery and Knowledge Transfer
Asset Return: Laptops (MacBook Pro / ThinkPad), YubiKeys, monitors, and building access badges must be
returned to IT Support within five (5) business days. Remote employees receive a prepaid, insured FedEx shipping
container.
Knowledge Transfer Sign-off: The departing employee and manager must complete and sign the Handover Matrix
documenting in-flight projects, credentials, and open Jira issues.
Final Settlement: Payroll processes statutory final pay and accrued unused PTO within jurisdictional deadlines
following asset recovery verification.
